## What this region is

What one lens layer shows: createLens builds the schema-only base lens, and a LensNarrowing hides surface (picks/omits/enum narrowing), scopes rows (where) and turns relations on, at the anchor, along a path or wherever a model appears.

## What it exists for

- Decide where a narrowing applies
- Keep things away from rule authors or out of results
- Limit which enum values a field allows
- Set up the base lens

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- a delegate layer below the org layer adds its own row clamp → lens-layers-and-clamps
- check that an AI-authored rule only references fields the lens shows → using-a-lens
- save each lens layer as a database record and rebuild it later → lens-layers-and-clamps
- declare the bridge from Salesforce Contact to Prisma User on crmId → field-maps-and-bridges
- load the dropdown options a field's source declares → option-sources
